repository_state.commit_message:
Persist Telegram message_id on interrupt-now dispatch

interrupt_dispatcher.py's notify() call got a message_id back in its
NotificationResult but never persisted it anywhere. Found this gap
today reprocessing 4 events that dispatched with bare threshold text
before PR #94's fix landed: there was no stored reference, so the bad
messages couldn't be deleted or edited, only left in the channel next
to the corrected resend.

Adds core_events.dispatch_message_id (migration 0198, applied) and
core/platform/event_bus.py::record_dispatch_message_id(), called from
interrupt_dispatcher.py right after mark_event_status("acknowledged").
